title: Unique Garlicky Dutch Fideo Pasta
description: A pescatarian friendly Dutch dish featuring fideo pasta, this recipe is a crowd pleaser with its garlicky and crumbly texture, served in a terracotta dish. It is a unique twist on traditional pasta dishes.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the fideo pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
Immediately plunge the cooked pasta into an ice bath to stop the cooking process and preserve texture.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the minced garlic until fragrant and lightly golden.
Add the diced smoked salmon to the skillet and cook until heated through, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked and chilled fideo pasta, the garlic and salmon mixture, and the grated cheese, tossing until the cheese is well distributed.
Stir in the chopped parsley, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper, and adjust seasoning as needed.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a terracotta dish and serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Let the dish rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
